intro.en: Custom ultrasonic-welded branch harnesses join multiple stranded conductors into a compact solid-state splice. Wire material, cross-sectional-area combination, stack order, strip and overlap dimensions, weld tooling, parameter window, branch protection and validation are developed as one controlled process.
intro.zh: 定制超声波焊接分支线束以固相连接方式把多根绞合导体形成紧凑焊点。线材材料、截面积组合、叠放顺序、剥线与搭接尺寸、焊接工装、参数窗口、分支防护与验证需要作为一套受控工艺开发。

knowledge.en: Ultrasonic metal welding applies clamping force and high-frequency relative motion to disrupt surface films and create intimate metal-to-metal contact without filler solder. A successful recipe is specific to conductor material, strand construction, bundle geometry, tooling and equipment.
knowledge.zh: 超声波金属焊接在压力下施加高频相对运动，破除表面膜并形成紧密的金属接触，不使用填充焊料。有效配方与导体材料、绞合结构、线束几何、工装和设备密切相关。

notes.en: Provide every wire material, plating, class and cross-sectional area; branch circuit and current; strip, overlap and insulation limits; splice location and package envelope; flex, fluids, temperature and vibration; target drawing or standard; volume, traceability and acceptance tests.
notes.zh: 请提供每根线的材料、镀层、类别与截面积，分支回路与电流，剥线、搭接和绝缘限值，焊点位置与包络，弯曲、介质、温度与振动，目标图纸或标准，以及数量、追溯和验收测试。

delivery.en: Release records the approved wire combination, stack and insertion direction, strip and overlap dimensions, weld nugget limits, tooling and machine identity, parameter window and monitoring limits, protection build, inspection criteria and validation evidence. A new wire combination or material is not treated as an automatic carry-over.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录批准的线材组合、叠放与插入方向、剥线和搭接尺寸、焊点限值、工装与设备身份、参数窗口和监控限值、防护结构、检验标准与验证证据。更换线材组合或材料不能自动沿用原工艺。

subtitle.en: A compact branch is the result of a validated process window.
subtitle.zh: 紧凑分支焊点，来自经过验证的工艺窗口

lead.en: The visible nugget is only the final trace of the process. Reliable production depends on conductor condition, bundle placement, tooling surface, amplitude, force, energy or time control, and objective inspection tied to the released wire combination.
lead.zh: 可见焊点只是工艺留下的最终结果。可靠量产取决于导体状态、线束摆放、工装表面、振幅、压力、能量或时间控制，以及与已放行线材组合绑定的客观检验。

title.en: Solid-State Wire Splicing Without Filler Metal
title.zh: 不使用填充金属的固相线束连接

copy.en: The sonotrode and anvil clamp the stripped bundle while ultrasonic motion produces local friction and plastic deformation. Surface oxides are disrupted and clean metal areas bond under pressure; the objective is not a molten pool. Compared with a splice barrel, the welded nugget can reduce package volume and eliminate a separate consumable, but only when the wire combination is weldable and the equipment window has been established. The process should not be described as soldering, resistance welding or a generic crimp.
copy.zh: 焊头与砧座夹紧已剥皮的导体束，高频振动在局部产生摩擦与塑性变形，破除表面氧化层并使洁净金属在压力下结合，目标并不是形成熔池。与接线套管相比，焊点可减小包络并取消独立连接耗材，但前提是线材组合具备可焊性且设备窗口已经建立。该工艺不应被称作锡焊、电阻焊或普通压接。

title.en: Material, Plating and Strand Construction Change Weldability
title.zh: 材料、镀层与绞合结构会改变可焊性

copy.en: Bare copper, copper alloy, tinned copper, aluminium and mixed-material combinations do not share one recipe. Strand diameter, conductor class, compacted construction, surface coating, lubricant, oxidation, storage and contamination alter friction and bonding. IEC 60352-9 covers defined ultrasonically welded connections using specified stranded or flexible copper, copper-alloy, aluminium and aluminium-alloy conductors; a customer drawing or applicable automotive requirement may narrow the scope further. Material identity and condition must therefore enter the controlled BOM and incoming criteria.
copy.zh: 裸铜、铜合金、镀锡铜、铝以及异种材料组合不能共用一套配方。单丝直径、导体类别、压缩结构、表面镀层、润滑剂、氧化、储存与污染都会改变摩擦和结合。IEC 60352-9 针对规定的绞合或柔性铜、铜合金、铝与铝合金导体给出超声波焊接连接要求；客户图纸或汽车要求还可能进一步缩小适用范围。因此材料身份与状态必须进入受控 BOM 和来料标准。

title.en: Cross-Section Ratio, Wire Count and Stack Order Matter
title.zh: 截面积比例、根数与叠放顺序都重要

copy.en: Total cross-sectional area sets only the starting point. A very small branch wire in a large bundle can move, cut or fail to participate in the weld; excessive wire count complicates placement and process capability. Wire ends need controlled overlap, and the stack should be defined rather than random. The branch direction, smallest-to-total area ratio, bundle width and height, conductor fan-out and the distance to nearby insulation are reviewed against the selected tooling and drawing. Splitting an oversized node into two controlled splices may be safer than forcing one dense nugget.
copy.zh: 总截面积只是起点。大线束中的极细分支可能移动、切伤或没有参与结合，过多根数也会增加摆放与过程能力难度。线端需要受控搭接，导体叠放不能随机。分支方向、最小线与总截面积比例、线束宽高、导体展开以及焊点到绝缘的距离，应结合工装与图纸共同审核。对过大的节点，拆成两个受控焊点往往比强行形成一个密集焊点更稳妥。

title.en: Strip Length and Placement Define the Weld Zone
title.zh: 剥线长度与摆放共同定义焊接区域

copy.en: Stripping must remove insulation without nicking, cutting or excessively spreading strands. The prepared length supports the specified overlap and leaves the insulation outside the tooling and weld zone. Operators or automated fixtures control insertion depth, wire end position and insulation setback; tangled strands, missing strands, bent wires and insulation trapped in the nugget are not cosmetic issues. Short-wire or twisted-pair constructions may need dedicated access tooling and a different preparation sequence.
copy.zh: 剥线要完整去除绝缘，同时避免划伤、切断或过度散开单丝。备线长度应满足规定搭接，并使绝缘位于工装与焊接区域之外。操作员或自动夹具要控制插入深度、线端位置与退皮距离；乱丝、缺丝、弯折以及绝缘夹入焊点都不是外观小问题。短线或双绞线结构还可能需要专用接近工装与不同备线顺序。

title.en: Amplitude, Force, Energy and Tool Condition Form a Window
title.zh: 振幅、压力、能量与工装状态共同形成窗口

copy.en: A weld program may control amplitude, normal force, energy, time, displacement or final weld height, depending on equipment. These variables interact: excess input can produce flash, strand damage or insulation heat, while insufficient input leaves weak or unstable bonding. Sonotrode and anvil pattern, wear, alignment and cleanliness change energy transfer. The released recipe therefore identifies the machine and tooling, defines parameter and monitoring limits, and uses trend data to detect drift; a green machine status is useful evidence only within the validated configuration.
copy.zh: 焊接程序可按设备控制振幅、法向压力、能量、时间、位移或最终焊点高度。这些变量相互影响：输入过多会造成飞边、单丝损伤或绝缘受热，输入不足则产生薄弱或不稳定结合。焊头与砧座纹路、磨损、对中和清洁也会改变能量传递。放行配方因此要识别设备与工装，规定参数和监控限值，并利用趋势数据发现漂移；只有处于已验证配置内，机器绿灯才是有意义的证据。

title.en: Protect the Nugget Without Creating a New Failure Point
title.zh: 保护焊点，同时避免制造新的失效点

copy.en: The bare nugget normally needs insulation and environmental protection selected for voltage, spacing, abrasion, fluids, temperature and service access. Heat-shrink, adhesive-lined tubing, molded covers, tapes or dedicated splice protectors differ in sealing, stiffness and repairability. Protection should cover exposed metal and stabilize the branch while keeping a gradual flex transition; a rigid sleeve ending at the first moving strand can concentrate fatigue. Sealing requirements and dielectric or ingress tests are defined separately from weld strength.
copy.zh: 裸露焊点通常需要按电压、间距、磨损、介质、温度和维护方式选择绝缘与环境防护。热缩管、带胶热缩、包胶盖、胶带或专用分支保护件在密封、刚度和可维修性上各不相同。防护应覆盖裸金属并稳定分支，同时保持渐进弯曲过渡；刚性保护套若终止在第一处活动单丝附近，可能造成疲劳集中。密封要求以及耐压或防护试验应与焊点强度分开定义。

title.en: Visual, Dimensional, Electrical and Mechanical Evidence
title.zh: 外观、尺寸、电气与机械证据缺一不可

copy.en: Routine inspection checks nugget width, height and length, wire overlap, insulation setback, strand participation, flash, burrs, discoloration and collateral damage. Electrical checks can include continuity and joint resistance with a defined four-wire or millivolt method where needed. Pull or peel testing, cross-section analysis and environmental sequences are destructive validation or audit tools rather than automatic 100% tests. Acceptance values come from the customer drawing, applicable standard and validated process—not from an unsupported generic number.
copy.zh: 常规检验关注焊点宽、高、长，导体搭接、绝缘退让、单丝参与、飞边、毛刺、变色与连带损伤。电气检查可包含导通和接点电阻，必要时规定四线法或毫伏压降方法。拉力或剥离、截面分析与环境序列属于破坏性验证或审核工具，并非自动用于 100% 检验。验收值来自客户图纸、适用标准与已验证工艺，而不是无依据的通用数字。

title.en: Branches for Vehicles, Appliances, Equipment and Power Distribution
title.zh: 用于车辆、家电、设备与电源分配的分支

copy.en: Ultrasonic splices are used in automotive and commercial-vehicle harnesses, battery and grounding networks, construction equipment, industrial machines, control panels and household appliances. Typical nodes distribute power or ground, join sensor returns, consolidate branch circuits or connect conductors to a terminal or contact. Wire-to-wire splices and wire-to-terminal welds are different configurations and may fall under different requirements—for example, USCAR-38 addresses automotive wire-to-terminal bonds, while wire-to-wire applications require their own applicable specification and qualification plan.
copy.zh: 超声波焊点可用于乘用车与商用车线束、电池与接地网络、工程机械、工业设备、控制柜和家用电器。典型节点用于分配电源或地、汇总传感器回路、合并分支，或把导体连接到端子与触点。线对线与线对端子属于不同配置，也可能适用不同要求；例如 USCAR-38 面向汽车线对端子结合，线对线应用则需要其自身适用规范与鉴定计划。

inputs.en: Every conductor material, plating, class, strand construction and cross-sectional area
inputs.zh: 每根导体的材料、镀层、类别、绞合结构与截面积

inputs.en: Circuit, current, voltage, branch direction, wire count and splice location
inputs.zh: 回路、电流、电压、分支方向、根数与焊点位置

inputs.en: Strip length, overlap, insulation setback, nugget envelope and protection build
inputs.zh: 剥线、搭接、绝缘退让、焊点包络与防护结构

inputs.en: Required drawing, IEC 60352-9, customer automotive specification or other acceptance basis
inputs.zh: 所需图纸、IEC 60352-9、客户汽车规范或其他验收依据

inputs.en: Temperature, vibration, flex, fluids, sealing and service environment
inputs.zh: 温度、振动、弯曲、介质、密封与维护环境

inputs.en: Prototype quantity, production volume, traceability, destructive test plan and limits
inputs.zh: 样品数量、量产规模、追溯、破坏性试验计划与限值

q.en: Is ultrasonic wire welding the same as soldering?
q.zh: 超声波线束焊接和锡焊一样吗？

a.en: No. It is a solid-state joining process using force and ultrasonic motion; it does not add solder or intentionally create a molten pool.
a.zh: 不一样。它利用压力与超声振动形成固相连接，不添加焊锡，也不以形成熔池为目标。

q.en: Can any copper and aluminium wires be welded together?
q.zh: 任何铜线和铝线都能直接焊在一起吗？

a.en: No. Material, plating, strand construction, area ratio, surface condition, tooling and equipment capability must be qualified for the exact combination.
a.zh: 不能。材料、镀层、绞合、面积比例、表面状态、工装与设备能力都要针对准确组合验证。

q.en: Can a validated recipe be reused after changing wire size?
q.zh: 更换线径后可以直接沿用原配方吗？

a.en: Not automatically. The new bundle changes geometry and energy transfer, so the process window and acceptance evidence require review.
a.zh: 不能自动沿用。新组合改变了几何与能量传递，需要重新审核工艺窗口与验收证据。

q.en: Does machine parameter monitoring replace pull testing?
q.zh: 设备参数监控可以代替拉力测试吗？

a.en: No. Monitoring controls production within an established window; destructive mechanical or section analysis helps establish or audit that window according to the plan.
a.zh: 不能。参数监控用于维持已建立窗口，破坏性机械或截面分析则按计划用于建立或审核窗口。

q.en: How is the welded branch insulated?
q.zh: 焊接分支如何做绝缘保护？

a.en: Depending on voltage and environment, options include heat-shrink, adhesive-lined tubing, tape, molded covers or dedicated protectors, with flex transition and sealing reviewed separately.
a.zh: 可按电压与环境选择热缩、带胶热缩、胶带、包胶盖或专用保护件，并单独审核弯曲过渡与密封。

a.en: Send the exact wire combination, circuit and current, branch geometry, strip and protection requirements, environment, drawing or standard, quantity, traceability and test limits.
a.zh: 请提供准确线材组合、回路与电流、分支几何、剥线和防护、环境、图纸或标准、数量、追溯与测试限值。
